svg.title: UNet++ dense skips and additive attention U-Net
svg.desc: Left-to-right executed differentiable forward graph; node labels rotate 90 degrees counterclockwise. Shapes and dependencies are exact. Glyphs use shared shape scales and an explicit visibility floor. Feature-map sheets and neurons are sampled. Constants and detached paths are not expanded.

g.text: UNet++ dense skips and additive attention U-Net
57 nodes | 573132 unique learned values | Flow / blocks
Shape scale: spatial linear; channels/vectors linear; floor 1 px. Sheets/neurons sampled; exact shapes in labels/tooltips.
